NEWSROOM READ
- Tennessee's DeSean Bishop tells his story of resilience and faith: Bishop discusses the No. 18 Vols' opening win over Furman and breaks down how his football journey led him many different places and taught him a lot about life.
- LaNorris Sellers learning lots with Gamecocks' OC Kendal Briles: Sellers discusses how he has raised his standard of play by putting in hard work all offseason with his new "co-pilot" Briles.
- Big Ten expanding access to replay reviews for football TV broadcasts: The Big Ten is expanding access to replay reviews for all television broadcasts of games officiated by the league, beginning with Saturday's contests.
- North Carolina reports violation, won't host recruits at ETSU game: Bill Belichick's North Carolina Tar Heels won't host recruits for Saturday's home opener against ETSU after self-reporting a recruiting violation.
